summary: This bill requires states to include fraudulent payments when reporting overpayments made under the Child Care and Development Block Grant Act of 1990 and to submit an annual report detailing improper payments, disaggregated by categories such as fraudulent payments, overpayments, and underpayments.

scores.thoughts: This bill amends the Child Care and Development Block Grant Act to require states to report on fraudulent payments, including suspected and verified fraudulent payments, overpayments, underpayments, and technically improper payments. This aims to reduce waste and fraud within a social safety net program, which aligns with reducing welfare spending.
